note: Some regions will have experienced significant biodiversity loss prior to 1970; this earlier loss will not be captured in this metric.
title: Living Planet Index by region
subtitle: The average relative decline in monitored wildlife [populations](#dod:population). The index value measures the change in abundance in 35,803 populations across 5,790 native species relative to the year 1970 (i.e. 1970 = 100%).
sourceDesc: World Wildlife Fund and Zoological Society of London (2026)
